classification: conditional finite-model coverage and algebra; external calibration still required
currentCalibration: No real calibration data or admitted c,p calibration receipts were supplied. Example boxes are synthetic coverage premises only.
implementationBoundary: Published cofailurePairs supplies raw observed pair rates. A new public K_eff interval API is not implemented or claimed by this mathematical preparation.

model.attribution: Observation-position names only under this population-sampling profile: lineage membership is resampled per cell/draw as in the O4 conditional population observation. Fixed source-to-lineage membership is outside this profile without its gamma_N conversion.
model.coverage: P(|Dhat-D|>=epsilon)<=min(1,1/(4T epsilon^2)); joint miss<=min(1,alphaD+betaP+betaC), without requiring calibration/data independence.
model.externalCalibration: Coverage-certified boxes forp,c with allocated marginal error budgets and provenance; neither inferred from agreement nor supplied by these synthetic fixtures.
model.frame: T independent identically distributed complete cells; N>=2 observations per cell, fixed or handed complete frame. No inference of iid from these bytes.
model.latent: Per cell, jointly independent Bernoulli(p) named lineages with declared normalized shares, shared copy probabilityc, fresh member draws. Latent/fresh randomness independent across cells.
model.mean: E U_t=2p(1-p)*(1-c^2*sum(w_l^2)) exactly for finiteN under this observation design.
model.members: Conditional population draws with replacement, independent given the cell latent lineages. Fixed lineage quotas/distinct finite-population member samples require their gamma_N correction and are not this profile.
model.optionalCap: A known deterministic cap is an explicit additional premise. A merely probabilistic cap would require another failure budget and is outside this profile.
model.output: Conditional outer enclosure for K_eff, not exact identified-set equality, latent causal groups, probability of truth or a physical count of independent sources.
model.statistic: U_t=(sum of discordant unordered member pairs)/choose(N,2)=2X_t(N-X_t)/(N(N-1)); Dhat=mean over whole cells. Shared-member pairs need not be independent.

value: Under the declared binary M0 conditional-population-iid member design, finite-cell pair discord has the published population disagreement mean. ForT jointly independent complete cells, the all-pairs average is a bounded whole-cell statistic: its tail is at most min(1,1/(4T epsilon^2)), not a bound withT multiplied by the number of pairs. External coverage-calibrated p,c boxes and their union error budgets propagate through the positive M0 denominator to a conditional outer K_eff enclosure. A denominator that may approach zero has no certified finite upper bound unless a valid external cap is declared. Missing calibration is unmeasured; an incompatible confidence box is not an unconditional rejection of the model. No finite interval establishes causal independence.
